{{EditSection|Badges/Fake}} Several '''Fake Badges''' were made during the [[Spring 2020 Event]] to disguise the fact that the game was part of the ROBLOX Egg Hunt 2020. All these badges had the same ID as a respective [[Spring 2020 Event|Spring 2020]] badge and were therefore "replaced" by another badge. {| class="fandom-table pad-10" style="width:100%; text-align: center;" ! style="width:175px;"|Icon !Name & Description |- |{{#tag:tabber|Current = [[File:ChocolateBadge.png|center|150px]] {{!}}-{{!}} Original = [[File:OTEBadge.png|center|150px]] {{!}}-{{!}} }} |'''[https://www.roblox.com/badges/2124516771/Obtained-Tower-of-Eggs Triumphed Spring 2020!]'''
